frontText: Navy 60 centered on a yellow door card. Dashed cut-line border. No other printed text.

items.title: Eastern Pacific haven
items.placementTarget: Board, in the eastern Pacific west of Central America, on the 100°W side of the equator.
items.text:
Name and access
this haven and open
Package 6 the first
time you move here.

havens.graticule: South of the faded printed 0° label and east of the printed 100°W meridian. Central America is the yellow coast at the top right; a further yellow coast is clipped at the right edge.
havens.namePlate: Blank white name plate directly above the anchor, with a pointer down to the disc.

printedRoutes.notes: A blue sea lane leaves the southeast side of the anchor and runs off the bottom-right corner. No city is printed at the far end. Door 67's Lima, to the southeast, has no matching line on that sticker.

redRegionLines: A vertical red line runs south along the printed 100°W meridian, from beneath the Central American coast to the bottom of the sticker. The haven sits east of this line.

mechanics.onFirstMove: Name and access this haven and open Package 6.
mechanics.notes: Population 3. Port. Blank name. No recon box.

summary: Eastern Pacific haven, population 3, blank name. The first move here names it and opens Package 6. A red region line runs south along 100°W, west of the haven. A sea lane leaves the haven toward the southeast and does not meet a city on this sticker.
